items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 15 at 1:16PM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
...HIGH RISK FOR RAPID FIRE GROWTH AND EXTREME FIRE BEHAVIOR WITH
ANY NEW FIRE STARTS THROUGH SATURDAY, DUE TO MODERATE TO LOCALLY
STRONG SANTA ANA WINDS AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY...

.Updates include adding the following areas to the previous Red
Flag Warnings - Ojai, Casitas, and the Santa Lucia Mountains.
Moderate to strong Santa Ana winds will peak around Friday then
slowly weaken through the weekend. Meanwhile, dry air will persist
and dry out any effects of the recent rains. Red Flag Warnings
are in effect for most of Los Angeles and Ventura Counties
Thursday through Saturday, and for interior Santa Barbara and San
Luis Obispo Counties for Friday.

* AFFECTED AREA...Most valleys and coasts of Los Angeles and
Ventura Counties.

* TIMING...Until 8 PM PDT Saturday.

* WINDS...Northeast to east 20 to 35 mph with gusts of 40 to 55
mph. Isolated gusts to 65 mph possible. Strongest Friday.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Minimums of 8 to 15 percent common.

* IMPACTS...If fire ignition occurs, conditions are favorable
for extreme fire behavior which would threaten life and
property.
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions
are either occurring now, or will shortly. Use extreme caution
with anything that can spark a wildfire. Residents near wildland
interfaces should be prepared to evacuate if a wildfire breaks
out. See readyforwildfire.org and wildfirerisk.org for
information.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 15 at 7:38AM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Wind Advisory, northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with
gusts of 35 to 55 mph expected. For the Heat Advisory, temperatures
up to 95 expected.

* WHERE...Coastal areas of southwest California

* WHEN...For the Wind Advisory, until 8 PM PDT Friday. For the Heat
Advisory, until 8 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result. Hot
temperatures may cause heat illnesses.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

In the event of a nearby wildfire, smoke may increase heat and
physical stress. If smoke impacts your area; 1) Have a cooling plan
in place as smoke could limit your ability to cool your home through
open windows and 2) If you have air conditioning, set on air
recirculation within the home to avoid smoke exposure. Local
officials may have additional guidance.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 15 at 8:35PM PDT until October 16 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
combined seas 2 to 5 ft expected when conditions are worst.

* WHERE...East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt.
Mugu CA including Santa Cruz Island and Inner waters from
Point Mugu to San Mateo Pt. CA including Santa Catalina and
Anacapa Islands.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 3 AM PDT Friday.
For the Gale Warning, from 3 AM to 5 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will create dangerous sea conditions
which could capsize or damage small and large vessels.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.
